evidence: Cic. N.D. 2.151: aurī vēnās invenīre (Lewis & Short)
Ter. Phorm. 1.2.18: montēs aurī pollicērī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The metal, and things made of it: gold plate, a gold cup, a ring, jewellery; also gold coin, money (Lewis & Short). Golden, made of gold, is aureus (see golden); a gold mine aurifodīna (Traupman 322).

phrases.latin: cum aliter rubeat ignis, aliter sanguis, aliter ostrum, aliter crocum, aliter aurum
phrases.english: since fire is red one way, blood another, purple another, saffron another, gold another

sources: Lewis & Short: aurum · Lewis & Short: aurifodina
